verdict.label: TEST-FIRST
verdict.p_go_note: upper bound: gates G1, G3, G4, G5 have no prior probability yet
reasons: G1 Aflatoxins (B1 and total): Aflatoxin B1 not measured; project threshold ≤ 10 µg/kg
G3 Heavy metals: Lead not measured; project threshold ≤ 1 mg/kg
G4 Solvent residue: Hexane residue not measured; project threshold ≤ 10 mg/kg
G5 Food-grade provenance: feed-grade or unknown supply and open or unknown storage: run a micro panel; re-source if possible

No anti-nutrient treatment needed: the dataset lists no anti-nutrient that exceeds a tolerance for this by-product (none are listed; confirm with literature). The constraints are allergen, price and protein level.
actions: Run afb1_elisa + afb1_hplc (G1); flips when Representative composite: B1 ≤ 10 µg/kg AND total aflatoxins ≤ 15 µg/kg.
Run icp_ms_metals (G3); flips when Lead ≤ 1.0; cadmium ≤ 0.1; total arsenic ≤ 0.5; mercury ≤ 0.1 mg/kg.
Run hexane_residue_gchs (G4); flips when Hexane residue ≤ 10 mg/kg (10 ppm), or confirmed non-solvent processing.
Run micro_panel (G5); flips when passing micro panel + hygienic supply.

utility.failure_cost_basis: variable cost of the campaign (our cost per kg raw cake × campaign size)
utility.description: U = campaign protein × margin vs pea if the spec is met and G1 passes; otherwise minus the campaign's variable cost. Selling as feed = 0. All in ₹ per decision (one pilot campaign).

voi.recommendation: No measurement can change the decision: decide now.
voi.note: EVSI = EVPPI × reliability; without an assay CV it is an upper bound (perfect test).

checks.label: ≥ 70% of the top 5 value drivers graded A/B

tests.name: Aflatoxin B1 ELISA screen
tests.method: ELISA on a composite sample (>= 10 sub-samples)
tests.sample_plan: Composite of ≥ 10 sub-samples from the lot (hot kernels: sampling error dominates)
tests.acceptance: AFB1 ≤ 10 µg/kg AND total B1+B2+G1+G2 ≤ 15 µg/kg on a representative composite (project thresholds)

tests.name: Aflatoxin B1 and total aflatoxins (HPLC)
tests.sample_plan: Composite of ≥ 10 sub-samples from the lot (hot kernels: sampling error dominates)
tests.acceptance: AFB1 ≤ 10 µg/kg AND total B1+B2+G1+G2 ≤ 15 µg/kg on a representative composite (project thresholds)

tests.name: Lead, cadmium, total arsenic and mercury (ICP-MS)
tests.method: ICP-MS (with As speciation for inorganic As)
tests.acceptance: lead ≤ 1 mg/kg; cadmium ≤ 0.1 mg/kg; arsenic ≤ 0.5 mg/kg; mercury ≤ 0.1 mg/kg (project thresholds; total arsenic)

tests.name: Hexane residue
tests.acceptance: Quantitative hexane residue ≤ 10 mg/kg, or confirmed non-solvent processing (project threshold)

tests.name: Microbiology panel
tests.method: Total plate count, yeast & mould, Salmonella
tests.acceptance: Total plate count and yeast & mould within spec; Salmonella absent

limitations: Inputs are sampled independently (no correlations between inputs).
Functionality fit (solubility, emulsification, gelation) is a qualitative flag, not a computed score.

Commercial isolate reference, not an oilseed cake. Qi et al. (2025), DOI 10.1016/j.fochx.2025.102898, reports 80.2% protein. Gellan gum 0.4% (w/v) and low NaCl (≤0.1 M) improved functional properties; NaCl ≥0.3 M weakened gels. The paper provides no purchase price, extraction yield, anti-nutrient reduction or process cost. These formulation findings are qualitative, not simulated treatments.
Off-flavour index not computable: no sensory baseline data for this by-product.

Treatments not considered: stabilise (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); moist_heat (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); phytase (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); soak_germinate (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); ssf_ferment (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); ae_iep (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); extrude (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model); ethanol_wash (Commercial isolate reference; no validated cake treatment model)
Value of information uses lower-bound costs, so margins (and test values) may be optimistic; gates without a prior (all but G1) are not part of the utility.
This is a proof of concept; the next step is laboratory validation.
